correctness.rationale: For fixed arrows, a source-basis change only reparametrizes the image matrix subspace, while a sink-basis change right-multiplies it; an arrow-space basis change is an independent left \(GL_n\) action. In the explicit \(K_3\) example every nonzero stacked matrix has rank two, and swapping the first two arrows changes the per-arrow rank tuple from \((1,2,1)\) to \((2,1,1)\), which is invariant under ordinary representation isomorphism. Thus the two representations are left-right matrix-space equivalent but not isomorphic for fixed arrows.
